premise: Martino is Tino's full name, the farm's little dog. Someone at the retreat put prototype AI glasses on him. The glasses took over and Martino ran off, and the longer they run the more of a monster he becomes. Beat him, the glasses fall off, and he is Tino again. Tone: Italian telenovela. Manga-style story cards between the fights (arena art, the bosses' poses, lines revealed one by one) and speech bubbles in the fights.

lines: Via Falchi. Tino the chihuahua is everyone's favourite.
Then someone put prototype AI glasses on him.
The glasses took over. Tino became Monster Martino and ran off.
Nonna saw it all. Get past her first!
story.text: Via Falchi. Tino the chihuahua is everyone's favourite. Then someone put prototype AI glasses on him. The glasses took over. Tino became Monster Martino and ran off. Nonna saw it all. Get past her first!

lines: Martino's tracks lead into the hazelnut woods.
The Peacock blocks the path. He wants an audience.
Beat him to follow the trail!
story.text: Martino's tracks lead into the hazelnut woods. The Peacock blocks the path. He wants an audience. Beat him to follow the trail!

lines: Venice. The glasses have been on too long.
That giant barking at pigeons is Martino.
story.text: Venice. The glasses have been on too long. That giant barking at pigeons is Martino. Break the glasses. Save Tino!

lines: The glasses crack and fall off.
Martino shrinks back into little Tino.
Back at the villa, everyone celebrates. Tino is saved!
You saved me! Grazie mille! Tino love you ❤
story.text: The glasses crack and fall off. Martino shrinks back into little Tino. Back at the villa, everyone celebrates. Tino is saved!

retry: Everyone is down. {boss} is still standing. Try again!

nonna.wipe: Too skinny, all of you. Again!

peacock.defeat: Oh right. Tino went to Venice.

euge.join: Nobody panics on my farm. Except the dog.
euge.down: Not in front of the guests!

jin.join: Gong xi fa cai! 恭喜发财
